title: Course Capstone: Your AI Transformation Story
description: Reflect on and document how you have changed as an AI user over this course — then design your next 90 days.
tools: Any AI tool for structure assistance
steps: Reflect on week 1 vs now: list 5 specific things you can do with AI that you could not before
Review all the projects you completed: which delivered the most value? Which would you use ongoing?
Identify the 3 most impactful AI habits you have developed
Design your "next 90 days" AI roadmap: what do you want to build, automate, or explore next?
Write a one-paragraph "AI literacy statement" — what you know, what you use, and what you value
expectedOutput: Your AI transformation story + a 90-day roadmap for what you'll build next.
bonusChallenges: Share your transformation with a colleague and help them start their own AI learning journey
Contribute to this course by documenting a new project idea based on your real work
